confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors follow Valparaíso cost-of-living surveys from June to October 2026, which vary and have small contributor samples. Cocktail is based on the local survey price relative to draft beer; wine is estimated at about 1.4 times beer. Accommodation is a holistic low-season estimate with greater uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Valparaíso survey benchmarks; accommodation reflects general knowledge of low-season stays in mid-sized Chilean coastal tourism cities.
